# Membrane MPEG-TS Plugin v0.6.2 - Table of Contents

> Membrane Multimedia Framework (MPEG-TS Plugin)

## Pages

- [Membrane Multimedia Framework: MPEG-TS](https://membrane-mpegts-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.MPEGTS.Muxer](https://membrane-mpegts-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.MPEGTS.Muxer.md): A Membrane Filter that provides muxing capabilities for the MPEG TS container.
- [Membrane.MPEGTS.Muxer.Engine](https://membrane-mpegts-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.MPEGTS.Muxer.Engine.md): A module with functionalities allowing for muxing stream into the MPEG-TS container.

- [Membrane.MPEGTS.Muxer.TS](https://membrane-mpegts-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.MPEGTS.Muxer.TS.md): Module responsible for wrapping PES and PSI into TS packets.
